Discover Scuba Diving – Take the Plunge!

Ever been fascinated by the underwater world but never had the courage to dive in? Not sure if scuba is for you? Our PADI Open Water Diver experience is the perfect way to test the waters!

Schedule & Duration

  • 📅 Monday to Friday
  • 📍 Meet at the dive school every day at 10:00 AM
  • 🤿 Includes 4 dive trips (each lasting 1.5 hours)
  • 🏊 Plus pool practice sessions to build confidence before heading into open water

What to Expect

In a relaxed setting, we’ll guide you through:

  • ✅ A short but thorough briefing on water pressure, underwater communication, and equipment use.
  • ✅ Breathing with a regulator and moving underwater with full gear.
  • ✅ Pool practice sessions to master the basics in a controlled environment.
  • ✅ A taste of key Open Water Diver techniques.
  • ✅ A final debrief to wrap up your experience.

Price: €550 per person (excl. VAT)

Included:

  • ✔ Pool entry
  • ✔ Full gear rental (fins, mask, tank, BCD, regulator, weights)
  • ✔ Full wetsuit
  • ✔ 4 dive trips (1.5 hours each)
  • ✔ Pool practice sessions
  • ✔ Insurance & admin fees

What to Bring

  • 🩱 Swimsuit
  • 🛁 Towel
  • 😁 A smile & a sense of adventure!

Who Can Join?

👉 Minimum age: 12 years (parental consent required for minors).

📄 Important: Before joining, you must complete and sign the PADI Diver Medical Form:

Download the form here.

📩 Send the completed form to info@scubasdiving.com at least 3 days before the start of your booked course.

Ready to Dive In?

Just click on register now!

Ready to explore the underwater world? 🌊 Join us for our Open Water Certification course and become a fully certified scuba diver in just a few days!

This internationally recognized certification will teach you the essential skills and knowledge to dive safely up to 18 meters, anywhere in the world. 🌍 Through a mix of theory sessions 📚, confined water practice 🏊, and open water dives 🐠, you'll gain hands-on experience with equipment handling, buoyancy control, underwater navigation, and safety procedures — all guided by our certified instructors.

No prior diving experience required ✅. By the end of the course, you'll walk away with a globally recognized diving certification 🏆 and the confidence to start your underwater adventures.

What's included:

✅ Full theory and practical training
🎒 All necessary equipment
👨‍🏫 Certified instructor guidance
📜 Official certification card upon completion

Spots are limited : sign up today and dive into your next adventure! 🐬🔥

Ready to take your diving to the next level? Join us for our Deep Cave Certification course and discover one of the most exhilarating and technical sides of scuba diving.

This advanced certification will teach you the specialized skills and knowledge needed to safely explore deep cave and overhead environments. Through in-depth theory sessions, guideline and navigation techniques, gas management, and supervised cave dives, you'll build the confidence and precision required for this demanding discipline — all guided by our experienced cave diving instructors.

Prior certification and diving experience required (open water and advanced/deep diver certification, depending on agency requirements). By the end of the course, you'll walk away with a recognized deep cave diving certification 🏆 and the skills to explore some of the most breathtaking underwater environments on earth.

What's included:

✅ Full theory and practical training
✅ Specialized cave diving equipment briefing
✅ Certified instructor guidance
✅ Official certification card upon completion

Spots are limited : sign up today and take your diving to new depths! 🌊
